intro.title: Creating Master Medicines
intro.subtitle: Brand name, salt composition, GST 2.0 (5%) tax slab, drug schedule, and physical rack assignment

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4: Inventory and Warehouse Operations! In Part 1, we cover creating master medicines in your item registry with brand names, salts, and GST 2.0 tax slabs.
From Inventory, click New Item. Enter the brand trade name like Augmentin 625 Duo, and specify the generic composition such as Amoxicillin and Potassium Clavulanate.
Set default MRP and selling price. Under GST Rate, select 5 percent reflecting GST 2.0 pharma reforms, and add the statutory eight-digit HSN code.
Configure packaging units and designate the regulatory schedule like Schedule H1, checking Prescription Required to enforce clinical verification at the counter.
Assign a physical rack and shelf location for lightning-fast picker retrieval, then save the item. In Part 2, discover packaging unit setups and strip-to-tablet conversions.

outro.takeaway: Medicine Master: Standardize trade names, salt molecules, GST 2.0 tax rates, and physical rack slots to streamline procurement and counter billing.
